uncited: This method refines coarse camera poses by learning a per-camera correction in the SE(3) Lie algebra space, conditioned on 2D image coordinates and a learnable embedding.
The method optimizes camera poses by predicting a local SE(3) transformation for each view, which is composed with the initial pose estimate.
The refinement is driven by a neural network (Warp MLP) that takes 2D pixel coordinates and a per-camera embedding as input.
*   Initial camera poses $P_{init} \in SE(3)^{N}$ (rotation $R_{init}$, translation $t_{init}$).
*   Per-camera embeddings $E \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d_{emb}}$.
*   Refined camera poses $P_{refined} \in SE(3)^{N}$.
*   Gradients for pose embeddings, MLP weights, and initial pose parameters.
*   Precomputed or dynamically gathered 3D coordinates of camera centers or ray origins, used to derive 2D projections.
*   Initialize initial poses $R_0, t_0$ from a coarse estimator (e.g., COLMAP).
*   Initialize per-camera embeddings $E$ randomly or with zeros.
*   For each optimization step, sample $N_{rays}$ pixel rays per image.
*   Retrieve the embedding for the current camera $i$: $e_i = E[i]$.
*   Concatenate 2D coordinates and embedding: $Input = \text{concat}(C_{2D}, E_{expanded}, dim=-1)$.
*   **Background Artifacts:** In LLFF joint optimization, applying multi-view correspondence and depth consistency losses from the start can cause the background to appear in front of the foreground.
*   **Hierarchical Sampling:** For LLFF, hierarchical sampling provides no significant benefit over a single MLP and increases training time.
*   **Memory Complexity:** The method introduces memory overhead for storing per-camera embeddings and the Warp MLP.
*   Joint optimization of poses and radiance fields.
*   Learnable per-camera embeddings allow for view-specific corrections.
*   Local SE(3) warps provide a stable optimization landscape compared to global pose updates.
*   **When Not to Use:** Not recommended for dense pose scenarios with high-quality initial estimates, as the overhead may not be justified.
Also, avoid if computational resources are severely limited due to the added complexity of the Warp MLP and embedding storage.
The method originates from research on optimizing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) from sparse and noisy poses.
